name: Hadamard matrix conjecture
question: Does a real Hadamard matrix exist for every positive order divisible by four?
dispatch_next: Add multiplier-group symmetry reduction to the Williamson meet-in-the-middle search so that n = 29 (order 116) becomes feasible, then implement Goethals-Seidel arrays for orders 156 and 172.
dispatch_why: Orders 116, 156 and 172 are engine gaps. The literature already constructs them. They are not the open case, which the probe frontier places at order 668.

campaign.method: Algebraic constructions (Sylvester, Paley, Williamson) with exact orthogonality certificates
campaign.hypothesis: A Hadamard matrix exists for every order divisible by 4.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Close the remaining engine gaps (116, 156, 172, ...) with symmetry-reduced Williamson and Goethals-Seidel constructions, then document the first order no implemented method reaches.
campaign.next_experiment: Add multiplier-group symmetry reduction to the Williamson meet-in-the-middle search so that n = 29 (order 116) becomes feasible, then implement Goethals-Seidel arrays for orders 156 and 172.
campaign.falsification: A proof that no Hadamard matrix of some order 4k exists; a finite search failure is not sufficient.
campaign.blocker: Plain meet-in-the-middle over symmetric circulants is practical up to n = 23 in pure Python; n = 29 needs symmetry reduction, and order 668 remains the smallest open case.

probes.name: Hadamard matrix conjecture
probes.title: Exact Hadamard matrices from Sylvester, Paley I/II and Kronecker products
probes.frontier: Known: constructions exist for every order 4k < 668; 668 is the smallest order with no known Hadamard matrix (after order 428, Kharaghani & Tayfeh-Rezaie 2005). Engine gaps below are NOT open cases.

smoke.scope: Explicit (+1/-1) matrices with H H^T = nI for 31 of the 32 orders 4k <= 128 (the rest are engine gaps, not open cases).

deep.scope: Explicit (+1/-1) matrices with H H^T = nI for 87 of the 100 orders 4k <= 400 (the rest are engine gaps, not open cases).

milestones.title: Exact Hadamard matrices for 31 of the 32 orders 4k <= 128, including order 92
milestones.scope: Known orders; the remaining engine gap 116 is not an open case
milestones.description: Sylvester, Paley I/II, a Williamson quadruple of symmetric circulants of order 23 (order 92, found by meet-in-the-middle on periodic autocorrelations) and Kronecker products; each matrix checked as H H^T = nI. The deep run certifies 87 of the 100 orders up to 400.

formal_statement.encodes: For every k ≥ 1 an Int matrix of order 4k with ±1 entries and pairwise orthogonal rows.

kernel_checked.claim: Explicit Hadamard matrices of orders 4, 8 (Sylvester) and 12 (Paley), re-checked by the kernel (order_4, order_8, order_12).
